source.check: Nominations from the Frontier Sentinel (6 May 1939, p. 5).

note: Triennial election, polled at the end of May 1939. Only six nominations were received for the 20 seats, so there was no contest; the remaining members were automatically returned. Filed on 1939-06-01, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1939-05-31 (verification 5 Nov 2026). The members deemed re-elected in the divisions with no nomination are recorded from reports of the council's meetings early in the term (Banbridge Chronicle), each with its division from the previous return or from the co-option report naming the predecessor (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
